title: Raise file-size ceiling in the implementer story, not at ship time
description: Workers run only typecheck+test per story, so a legitimate file growth trips the file-size ratchet late (ship/CI gates-failed) and gets a manual ceiling raise by the orchestrator. Fix: have the implementer run check:file-size after coding and, for its own legitimate growth, raise scripts/file-size-budget.json to the measured actual with the tracker-ref in _ref in the SAME story commit; the reviewer backstops that each raise is justified vs splitting the file (preserving the ratchet's friction). Also fix the stale patterns.md:116 pointer that references the removed cam-ship.md Step 3 (ship is now ship-runner.ts). Both agent files are dual-copied (.claude/ + templates/).
